content: Planar RGB homography may retain multiple visible motion candidates. For a rigid eye-in-hand camera, compare candidate rotation angles with measured-joint relative rotation, a scale-free necessary invariant. Never select the first or sole visible candidate as calibrated pose; decomposition translation is divided by plane distance, not meters.
applicability: Static planar target, fixed camera mount, qualified RGB intrinsics, local correspondences; report failures of these assumptions as UNKNOWN
count_semantics: One completed input audit, no calibration or robot task successes
limitations: No unique physical root cause or parameter fit
